🚨 We’re Hiring | Store Manager

We are looking for an experienced Store Manager with hands-on expertise in dark store operations within the F&B industry to manage daily activities, inventory, and order fulfilment efficiently.

📍 Location: Mysore
💼 Experience: 2+ Years
📌 Industry: F&B (Food & Beverage)

* 2+ years of experience in dark store or store operations within F&B.
* Manage end-to-end dark store operations and order fulfilment.
* Oversee inbound, picking, packing, dispatch, and inventory management.
* Maintain stock accuracy and ensure proper food storage and handling.
* Lead store teams and manage manpower effectively.
* Monitor productivity, order timelines, and operational KPIs.
* Ensure hygiene, food safety, and SOP compliance.
* Resolve operational issues and improve store efficiency.
